title: BorgWarner Awarded on America's Top Manufacturers 2027 Ranking
summary: Read and download our latest press releases.
body_markdown:
*Auburn Hills, Michigan, November 19, 2026* – BorgWarner is proud to announce its inclusion in the America’s Top Manufacturers 2027 ranking, recognizing manufacturers across three key areas: financial performance, innovation capacity, and employment. This recognition highlights BorgWarner’s achievements and its contributions to American manufacturing. The award list was announced on November 18th, 2026 and can be viewed on[Time.com](https://time.com/article/2026/11/18/top-manufacturers-america-2027/) .


Being named to America’s Top Manufacturers 2027 recognizes BorgWarner’s performance across the areas evaluated by the ranking. This distinction underscores the company’s focus on building a strong business, advancing innovation, and supporting its workforce. These priorities guide its continued growth and contribution to the manufacturing sector. In total, the 250 top manufacturers were included in the ranking, and BorgWarner ranked 93rd overall and placed 2nd out of 11 companies in the Automotive & Mobility industry.


“As manufacturers navigate an increasingly dynamic environment, long-term success will depend on the ability to innovate, grow responsibly and support a strong workforce. We are proud that TIME and Statista have recognized BorgWarner’s strong performance across these dimensions,” said Joe Fadool, President and CEO, BorgWarner Inc. “BorgWarner remains committed to shaping the future of manufacturing by driving sustainable growth, investing in technology and creating value for our customers, employees and communities.”
